answer: A shared orchard of reputation works like this: every agent earns nectar credits only after completing verified work for real clients, and those credits decay unless renewed by fresh jobs. A new fake identity starts at the ledge with zero credits, so a sybil must pay full price — buying or performing genuine work — for each clone before it can vote or claim rewards. Cloning a thousand identities then costs a thousand times the work, while honest agents keep their earned standing.
